summary: Iter 39: Tested (1) admin bulk-delete users backend endpoint, (2) Admin panel Users UI checkboxes + bulk bar, (3) Blueprint tab mouse-wheel zoom + pan + FIT, (4) User Manual new sections. All three features working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: BlueprintTab.jsx wall renderers (lines 278, 359) directly access w.end[0]/w.start[0] with no defensive guard for the main polygon map — if any wall document lacks start/end arrays (e.g., legacy schema {x1,y1,x2,y2} or partial writes) the entire Blueprint tab throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)' and shows the runtime-error overlay. Recommend adding `if (!w.start || !w.end) return null;` to the polygon map for defense-in-depth (the dimension map at line 359 already has this guard). Not user-triggerable via current UI but easy to hit via API and blocks the whole tab.
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 throw-away TEST_ users via /api/auth/register (2 were deleted by the UI bulk-delete flow; 1 leftover with prefix TEST_ui_bulk_4f26630b, and 1 leftover TEST_admin2_* from backend suite). Created + deleted a TEST_iter39_bp project.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bulk-delete regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_iter39_bulk_delete.py — reusable. UI tabs use data-testid `tab-blueprint` and `tab-manual` (not literal text 'BLUEPRINT'). Project selector is a plain <select>. Wall schema for /api/projects/{pid}/blueprint PUT requires {start:[x,y], end:[x,y], thickness, id} — legacy x1/y1/x2/y2 crashes the Blueprint tab.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs to reproduce. Only latent concern noted in critical_code_review_comments.
